candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs to confirm the underlying redis fault versus network latency.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout, matching the alert's ~2s 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2406ms) and 502s. Redis-side evidence is absent, so confidence is moderate.
